message.content: {"items":[{"title":"EUROPEAN WORKING CONDITIONS SURVEY 2010","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10986","justification":"This European survey includes questions on occupational health and working conditions and covers EU member states (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, Finland, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia) plus some additional countries in the 2010s."},{"title":"EUROPEAN WORKING CONDITIONS SURVEY 2015","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12660","justification":"EWCS 2015 contains extensive data on working conditions and occupational health (e.g., exposure to risks, health outcomes) across many of the requested European countries during the 2010s."},{"title":"EUROPEAN WORKING CONDITIONS SURVEY 2015, 35 COUNTRIES","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=6972","justification":"This GESIS dataset version specifies coverage of 35 countries including EU member states and some non‑EU (such as Norway, Switzerland, Turkey) with occupational health variables, and the fieldwork is within the mid‑2010s."},{"title":"EUROPEAN WORKING CONDITIONS SURVEY 2010, 34 COUNTRIES","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=5055","justification":"GESIS catalogue entry for the 2010 EWCS; includes working environment, physical and psychosocial risk factors, and health outcomes for many of the listed European countries in 2010."},{"title":"EUROPEAN SOCIAL SURVEY 2010 (ROUND 5) – MODULE ON WORK AND WELL‑BEING","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11025","justification":"ESS Round 5 (2010) includes a rotating module on work, family and well‑being with items on work‑related stress and health; it covers many of the named European countries in the early 2010s."},{"title":"EUROPEAN SOCIAL SURVEY 2015 (ROUND 7) – WORK‑RELATED ASPECTS OF WELL‑BEING","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12430","justification":"ESS Round 7 (2014–2015) includes repeated items on work and well‑being, capturing aspects of occupational health and psychosocial working conditions in many of the listed countries during the 2010s."},{"title":"EUROPEAN COMPANY SURVEY 2013","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=10078","justification":"This survey examines company practices related to work organization and human resource management including health and safety policies; it covers multiple European countries (EU and associated) in 2013, relevant to occupational health context."},{"title":"SURVEY OF HEALTH, AGEING AND RETIREMENT IN EUROPE (SHARE) WAVE 4 (2011)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11448","justification":"SHARE includes older workers and retirees with detailed health information and employment histories. Wave 4 (around 2010–2011) covers several of the requested European countries and can be used to study occupational health over the life course in the 2010s."},{"title":"SURVEY OF HEALTH, AGEING AND RETIREMENT IN EUROPE (SHARE) WAVE 5 (2013)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12288","justification":"Similar to Wave 4, SHARE Wave 5 offers health and work‑history data for many of the included European countries in 2013, allowing analyses of later‑life health in relation to occupational histories during the 2010s."},{"title":"SURVEY OF HEALTH, AGEING AND RETIREMENT IN EUROPE (SHARE) WAVE 6 (2015)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12660","justification":"SHARE Wave 6 continues to cover numerous European countries with variables on health, functional limitations, and employment/retirement; it is suitable for studying occupational health issues among older adults in the mid‑2010s across several of the named countries."}]}
